Tax Transactions

The Tax Transactions report displays a detailed list of all transactions that contain tax codes within a specified date range.

This report helps you analyze tax-related activity by showing which transactions have contributed to your tax obligations or credits.

Each transaction is listed with its date, reference number, description, account, and the tax amount calculated based on the applied tax code.

Use this report to verify that tax has been correctly applied to transactions and to identify specific transactions for tax reporting purposes.

Description

Add an optional description or note that will appear on the report.

From

The starting date for transactions to include in the report.

To

The ending date for transactions to include in the report.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.
